content:
- run: |
    missing=0
    for f in .github/workflows/*.yml .github/workflows/*.yaml; do
      [ -e "$f" ] || continue
      if ! grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*permissions:' "$f"; then
        echo "Workflow $f missing permissions:"
        missing=$((missing+1))
      fi
    done
    if [ $missing -ne 0 ]; then
      exit 1
    fi
